package.description: Virtual PDF printer for Windows - print to PDF and hand it to a configurable target application.

en-US.description: Virtual PDF printer for Windows - print to PDF and hand it to a configurable target application.
en-US.longDescription:
miPDFconvert is a virtual PDF printer for Windows. Install it, print to the
miPDFconvert printer from any application, and get a PDF - either handed
automatically to a configurable target application or saved through a dialog.
Based on clawPDF/mfilemon. Ghostscript (AGPL) is bundled - no separate
Ghostscript installation is needed. Installer and miPDFconvert binaries
are Authenticode-signed.
en-US.name: miPDFconvert
